title: Closed support of proper pushforward lies in image
statement: Let Z be Noetherian, q : Y → Z proper, and F coherent on Y. If C is a closed subset equal to the support of F, then the support of q_*F is a closed subset D of Z contained in q(C).

source.place: Theorem 088E, support of H paragraph; Tag 02O5

proof.text: Properness makes q locally of finite type, so Y is locally Noetherian. Apply isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType to F.property to obtain quasi-coherence. On each affine open V of Y, coherent_affine_sections_finite gives finite sections over the Noetherian coordinate ring. Mathlib finitePresentation_of_finite and the affine finite-presentation criterion give finite presentation of F.over V. Apply IsFinitePresentation.of_coversTop to the affine open cover to obtain finite presentation of F.

The Grothendieck-abelian instance for Y.Modules gives injective resolutions. Apply isFinitePresentation_higherDirectImage in degree zero. The pushforward is left exact, so rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf identifies the degree-zero right derived functor with ordinary pushforward. Transport finite presentation along this isomorphism. Finite presentation implies both quasi-coherence and finite type by Mathlib instances.

Apply finite_type_module_support_closed to the ordinary pushforward. Its last conjunct proves closedness of the nonsubsingleton-stalk set; define D to be this set paired with that closedness proof. Its support equality is reflexive.

Properness makes q a closed map, hence T = q(C) is closed. For y in Supp(F), the supplied equality hC shows y belongs to C; therefore q(y) belongs to T. Apply pushforward_support_subset_of_closed_support with this inverse-image support inclusion to get Supp(q_*F) contained in T. This is the desired inclusion for D. No inhabitedness or nonzero hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem pushforward_support_closed_subset
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (F : CoherentModules Y)
    (C : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Y)
    (hC : (C : Set Y) = {x : Y | ¬ Subsingleton (F.obj.presheaf.stalk x)}) :
    ∃ D : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Z,
      (D : Set Z) =
        {x : Z | ¬ Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj).presheaf.stalk x)} ∧
      (D : Set Z) ⊆ q '' (C : Set Y)
